data.title: 神尾观铃 · 临海平交道的落日电车与冰饮
data.description: 海边平交道栏杆旁，夕阳将铁轨和整个海湾染成醉人的绯金。观铃提着刚从自动贩卖机买来的冰镇蜜桃汁等待电车驶过，晚风拂过水手服缎带，眼眸映照着晚霞。
data.location: coastal railway level crossing barrier overlooking a sparkling sunset ocean bay
data.action: standing beside crossing gate holding a chilled canned drink, watching train approach, evening breeze rustling sailor tie, serene gentle smile
data.lighting: 晚霞将海面与铁轨染透的赤金逆光
data.promptProse: Misuzu stands by a coastal railroad crossing gate holding a cold drink, watching the sunset train pass as evening sea winds flutter her uniform.
data.animaCaption: Golden evening light sparkles across the coastal tracks as she waits quietly with her drink.
